summary.quick_take: Webflow and Squarespace both sit in the broader website builder landscape, but they appeal to slightly different buying motions. Webflow leans into recurring payouts, while Squarespace leans into one-time payouts. The better fit depends on whether you want the cleaner affiliate story, the broader positioning angle, or both.
